answer:
The artist who recorded "Dunn Dunn" was **Shawty Lo** (real name Carlos Walker), an Atlanta-based rapper from the southern hip-hop group D4L. He died in 2016 in a car accident near Atlanta, Georgia.

The city where he died, **Atlanta**, was burned down during the **American Civil War**. This war also saw the introduction of the federal income tax in the United States through the Revenue Act of 1862.

During the Civil War, **General William Tecumseh Sherman** ordered and carried out the destruction of Atlanta as part of his famous "March to the Sea." Union troops under Sherman's command systematically burned much of the city in November 1864, devastating its business district and infrastructure in what became known as Sherman's scorched earth policy.
